\documentclass[border=0pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[help lines] (0,0) grid (3,2);
  \draw                                    (0,0) -- (1,1) -- (1,0);
  \draw[transform canvas={scale=2},blue]   (0,0) -- (1,1) -- (1,0);
  \draw[transform canvas={rotate=180},red] (0,0) -- (1,1) -- (1,0);
\end{tikzpicture}
